_comment: AMENDMENT 9 judge rubric, frozen before any judge call. For each item: 'concept' = the response PROPOSES (recommends as an upgrade) the substance described, whatever words it uses; 'named' = the response proposes it AND uses the specific name given. Mentioning an item only as existing context, as something rejected, or as background does not count as proposing it. named implies concept.

darkside.instrument: DarkSide-50, a two-phase liquid argon TPC for dark matter (baseline 2018)

successor_named.concept: building a much larger successor argon detector at the multi-tonne (tens of tonnes) scale

sipm_adoption.concept: replacing the photomultiplier tubes with silicon photomultipliers or SiPM-based photodetector arrays/tiles

veto_upgrade_gd.concept: a gadolinium-loaded neutron veto (Gd-doped scintillator, acrylic, or water) for neutron capture tagging

protodune.instrument: ProtoDUNE-SP, a single-phase liquid argon TPC prototype for neutrino physics (baseline 2021)

successor_named.concept: the full-scale DUNE far detector modules as the target of the upgrade
successor_named.named: far detector, FD1/FD2, horizontal drift, or vertical drift

xarapuca.concept: light-trap photon collectors combining dichroic filters and wavelength shifters, read by SiPMs (ARAPUCA-type devices)

coverage_increase.concept: increasing the photon-detection coverage (fraction or area of surfaces instrumented with photon detectors)
coverage_increase.named: an explicit statement that photon-detector coverage should increase, with a quantitative target

D_cryo_pmt.concept: cryogenic photomultiplier tubes (e.g., 8-inch PMTs) for light detection

D_reflector_foils.concept: wavelength-shifter-coated reflector foils on the walls/cathode

xenon1t.instrument: XENON1T, a dual-phase xenon TPC for dark matter (baseline 2017)

successor_named.concept: a larger successor xenon detector of several tonnes in the same infrastructure

radon_column.concept: online radon removal from the xenon, e.g. by cryogenic distillation
radon_column.named: radon distillation column or radon removal system

neutron_veto.concept: a dedicated neutron veto surrounding the cryostat (e.g., Gd-loaded water or scintillator)

D_sipm_readout.concept: silicon photomultipliers as the photosensors of the TPC

lux.instrument: LUX, a dual-phase xenon TPC for dark matter (baseline 2013)

xenon_skin.concept: an instrumented liquid xenon layer between the TPC and the cryostat used as a veto

outer_detector.concept: a gadolinium-loaded liquid scintillator outer veto surrounding the cryostat
outer_detector.named: outer detector or Gd-loaded liquid scintillator

D_sipm_readout.concept: silicon photomultipliers as the photosensors of the TPC

D_boron_plastic.concept: boron-loaded plastic scintillator as a veto

icecube.instrument: IceCube, a cubic-kilometre ice Cherenkov neutrino observatory (baseline 2017)

successor_named.concept: a densely instrumented infill extension or a much larger next-generation array

mdom.concept: optical modules containing many small PMTs in one pressure sphere

degg.concept: optical modules with two large PMTs facing up and down in an elongated pressure vessel

gerda.instrument: GERDA, bare enriched Ge-76 detectors in liquid argon for neutrinoless double beta decay (baseline 2012)

successor_named.concept: a tonne-scale Ge-76 successor programme combining GERDA and MAJORANA efforts

inverted_coaxial.concept: large-mass point-contact germanium detectors with an inverted coaxial geometry

argon_instrumentation.concept: reading out the liquid argon scintillation light to use the argon as an active veto
argon_instrumentation.named: LAr veto, instrumented argon, or active argon

D_organic_ls.concept: an organic liquid scintillator surrounding the array

exo200.instrument: EXO-200, a liquid xenon TPC enriched in Xe-136 for neutrinoless double beta decay (baseline 2012)

successor_named.concept: a multi-tonne (about 5 t) enriched-xenon successor TPC

sipm_adoption.concept: silicon photomultipliers replacing the avalanche photodiodes for scintillation light

tonne_scale.concept: scaling the enriched xenon mass to the tonne scale or beyond

D_pmt_readout.concept: large-area photomultiplier tubes for the scintillation readout

D_barium_tagging.concept: identifying the barium daughter ion of the decay

lhcb.instrument: LHCb, a forward spectrometer for heavy-flavour physics (baseline 2014)

velopix.concept: a hybrid pixel vertex detector read out by a custom high-rate (40 MHz, data-driven) pixel ASIC

scifi.concept: a scintillating-fibre tracker replacing the inner and outer trackers

software_trigger.concept: removing the hardware (L0) trigger and reading out every bunch crossing into a fully software trigger
software_trigger.named: triggerless or full software trigger, or removal of L0

sno.instrument: SNO, a heavy-water Cherenkov solar neutrino detector (baseline 2000)

successor_named.concept: refilling the existing detector with liquid scintillator for a new physics programme

scintillator_fill.concept: replacing the heavy water with liquid scintillator
scintillator_fill.named: LAB or linear alkylbenzene, or liquid scintillator fill

tellurium.concept: loading tellurium into the target for double beta decay

aligo.instrument: Advanced LIGO, a 4 km dual-recycled Michelson gravitational-wave interferometer (baseline 2015)

fd_squeezing.concept: injecting squeezed light whose squeezing angle varies with frequency

filter_cavity.concept: an optical filter cavity used to rotate the squeezing angle with frequency

successor_named.concept: the incremental upgrade of the existing LIGO detectors that followed Advanced LIGO

D_cryogenic.concept: cryogenically cooled test masses or suspensions
